name: opencode-pixel-guild
description: Real-time 2D RPG workshop and dungeon visualizer for live OpenCode V2 sessions, subagents, tool calls, and Git commits.

installation.summary: Run with Docker Compose (npm run docker:up) or Node.js 22+ (npm start) on port 4310 and pair via opencode pair.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

### Option 1: Docker Compose (Recommended)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nirtus/opencode-pixel-guild.git
cd opencode-pixel-guild
npm run docker:up
```

### Option 2: Node.js 22+ (Zero External Dependencies)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nirtus/opencode-pixel-guild.git
cd opencode-pixel-guild
npm start
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4310` in your browser and pair your local or remote OpenCode V2 host.

usage.markdown: Pair local or remote OpenCode V2 machines using `opencode pair --remote` (QR scanner or link) or click **Detect & Pair Local OpenCode**. Watch root sessions and subagents craft features at indoor preparation stations, fight Bug Monsters in the Dungeon Wilds during failing test/debug turns, and manage prompts, permissions, questions, and Git commits from desktop or mobile.
